items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-03-22
items.q: He was going with the Auburn Twins' sister.

ctx.x: So he construed that that was the back door.

Yeah, so, yeah, so I went there, I said, Buddy, look, I said, man, look, I have told you before, because I knew what kind of fellow was. I said, when you have problems, I said, don't you jump to conclusions, let me handle it. And, oh, he's doing something. I said, but you got the wrong concept, man, because the dumb man was only telling you, right? And we all unload our stuff right from that ramp. But he's still there winning his job. Oh, sure. Yeah, that's the way he was. I've never had, I can't remember having…
Okay. He just got warm next time. Yeah, that's probably him. Yeah. He just got warm. Uh.
